description: This is a Java source file defining the PaymentTypeHelper class, which provides utility methods for managing payment types via API calls, including creation, retrieval, update, and deletion within the Fineract project integration tests.

classes.name: PaymentTypeHelper
classes.description: A helper class for managing payment types in Fineract integration tests, providing methods to create, retrieve, verify, update, and delete payment types via API calls.

methods.name: getAllPaymentTypes
methods.description: Retrieves all payment types, optionally filtering with code.

methods.name: createPaymentType
methods.description: Creates a new payment type with the provided request data.

methods.name: verifyPaymentTypeCreatedOnServer
methods.description: Verifies that a payment type with the given ID exists on the server and matches expected ID.

methods.name: retrieveById
methods.description: Retrieves payment type data by ID using API.

methods.name: retrieveById (deprecated)
methods.description: Retrieves payment type data by ID via server get request, using request/response specifications.

methods.name: updatePaymentType
methods.description: Updates an existing payment type with given ID and request data.

methods.name: deletePaymentType
methods.description: Deletes a payment type by ID.

methods.name: randomNameGenerator
methods.description: Generates a random name string with a given prefix and suffix length.
